hero.badge: Professional HVAC, Electrical & MEP Engineering in Bali
hero.title: High-Performance Air Conditioning, MEP & Electrical Solutions
hero.subtitle: Bali Electrical Solutions delivers HVAC, ducting, ventilation, acoustic soundproofing, and MEP for villas, hotels, and commercial buildings in Bali.

about.title: Reliable mechanical & electrical solutions for every building in Bali
about.description: From private villas to commercial establishments, we manage engineering design, installation, and lifecycle maintenance for HVAC, ventilation, acoustics, and MEP with precision craftsmanship.
bullets: Trusted by villas, luxury resorts, and businesses
about.description1: Bali Electrical Solutions is a premier engineering contractor dedicated to luxury villa owners, resort operators, commercial buildings, and industrial facilities requiring top-tier climate control, dependable power systems, and durable mechanical installations.
about.description2: With deep understanding of Bali's high ambient humidity and aggressive coastal air salinity, our engineers design every system to ensure exceptional durability, maximum thermal comfort, and optimized energy efficiency.
about.visionDesc: To set the standard of excellence for MEP and HVAC engineering across Bali through sustainable innovations and energy-efficient design.
about.missionDesc: Delivering uncompromising installation quality, prioritizing safety standards, international compliance, and rapid-response lifecycle support.

services.title: Complete Engineering Solutions 01 to 06
services.subtitle: From precision climate control design to integrated MEP installations, we ensure every element of your building operates efficiently and reliably across Bali's tropical conditions.

services.title: Complete Engineering Solutions From 01 to 06
services.subtitle: Our integrated services ensure optimum indoor air quality, thermal comfort, noise control, and robust mechanical-electrical infrastructure.

hvac.title: HVAC & Air Conditioning
hvac.description: Design, installation, and maintenance of high-efficiency air conditioning systems (VRV/VRF, chillers, concealed ducted units) for premium residential and commercial spaces.

ducting.title: Ducting Fabrication & Installation
ducting.description: Precision fabrication and installation of PIR pre-insulated ducting, galvanized steel (BJLS) ductwork, and spiral ducts with superior thermal vapor barrier insulation.
features: High condensation resistance for humid environments
Aerodynamic design reducing air friction & energy loss
Architectural diffusers, linear grilles, and dampers

freshAir.title: Fresh Air & Circulation Systems
freshAir.description: Filtered outdoor fresh air intake systems to sustain oxygen circulation, maintain positive room pressure, and eliminate mold/mildew in air-conditioned spaces.
features: Integrated dehumidification for incoming humid air
Elimination of stuffiness and moisture-induced odors

ventilation.title: Industrial & Commercial Ventilation
ventilation.description: Heavy-duty exhaust and ventilation systems for commercial hotel and restaurant kitchens (hoods), generator rooms, basements, and laundry facilities.
features: Commercial kitchen hoods with smoke/grease filtration

acoustic.title: Acoustic Attenuation & Soundproofing
acoustic.description: Engineered noise reduction and vibration dampening for chiller plants, generator enclosures, rooftop fans, and luxury villa mechanical rooms.

mep.title: MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing)
mep.description: Full electrical panel fabrication, low/medium voltage power distribution, lightning protection grounding, and domestic clean/wastewater plumbing systems.
features: Power cabling, load balancing & lightning protection
Pressurized clean water, booster pumps & drainage piping
